text:
olivia (eng): hey team — I converted from contractor to full-time last month. Will I get the employer 401k match retroactively for the period I was on payroll as a contractor? also, I had an unpaid medical leave for 2 weeks in that window — does that affect the match or HSA pre-tax contributions?
kelly (People Ops): congrats on the conversion! :tada: short answer: match eligibility starts on your first full paycheck as an employee per policy, retroactive makes depends on payroll timeline and whether we can do an off-cycle correction. can you share the exact dates of status change + the unpaid leave dates?
olivia (eng): status change effective 2026-02-10, first ft paycheck 2026-02-26. unpaid medical leave 2026-02-15 -> 2026-02-28 (unpaid). wondering if match should cover pay period 2/1-2/14 (contractor) or any of february after conversion.
kelly (People Ops): thanks. policy detail: employer match applies to eligible employee contributions on paychecks after conversion. since your first FT pay was 2/26, automatic match will apply starting that paycheck. Retro match for earlier pay periods (while contractor) is not automatic. if you have employee contributions taken during the pay periods after conversion that should qualify. For the unpaid leave: unpaid days reduce eligible pay for that paycheck; we compute match on the actual deferral amounts withheld.
ben (Benefits): adding detail from benefits/vendor side: if you want a retroactive employer match for the payroll period where we missed applying (e.g., payroll mis-tagged conversion), we can request an off-cycle employer contribution. process is: 1) People Ops submits Off-cycle Match Request + justification, 2) Payroll runs off-cycle Journal and transmits to vendor, 3) vendor posts employer contribution to your 401k account. expect 2-3 pay cycles to complete.
payroll-bot: TRIGGERED: Off-cycle contribution requires docs: CompStatusChangeForm.pdf + EmployeeDeferralHistory.csv + ManagerApproval email thread. See link: https://intra/payroll/offcycle-guides
kelly (People Ops): olivia — please reply with the CompStatusChangeForm signed and mention if you want us to include unpaid leave in the calculation (we usually pro-rate by actual deferrals). I can kick off the off-cycle if manager approves.
james (manager): i approve the off-cycle match for olivia. pls proceed. :white_check_mark:
kelly (People Ops): noted. @payroll-bot can you confirm ETA if we submit today? also @ben can you confirm vendor plan id we should use for the off-cycle posting?
payroll-bot: ETA: off-cycle request queued. target processing 2026-03-12. Required file format examples: 
```
EmployeeDeferralHistory.csv
employee_id,period_start,period_end,deferral_amount
O12345,2026-02-01,2026-02-14,0.00
O12345,2026-02-15,2026-02-28,120.00
```
please ensure employee_id matches payroll system.
ben (Benefits): vendor plan ids: our main 401k is PLAN-RED-401 (vendor code 7102). If off-cycle is sent under the wrong plan code the posting will fail. For HSA: vendor is HSA-TRUST-01 (code 3301). If you need to split employer contributions between 401k and HSA (e.g., voluntary wellness credit) call benefits first.
olivia (eng): got it — i'll upload the CompStatusChangeForm and the deferral CSV in the HR ticket. quick Q: for the unpaid medical leave window, will HSA deductions stop automatically during unpaid period? i didn't see any HSA deferral on the 2/28 stub.
\elly (People Ops): small typo in prev message => kelly (People Ops): HSA deferrals are payroll-driven. if there are no wages in a pay period, there will be no pre-tax deferral for that pay period. we can make up missed employee HSA contributions via an after-the-fact payroll adjustment (taxable or pre-tax depending on timing) but it requires coordination with benefits and payroll. generally we don't shift taxes retroactively past 60 days without a documented reason.
ben (Benefits): to add — vendor will accept a pre-tax catch-up if sent as a pre-tax off-cycle reversal within the plan year and payroll codes are correct. Otherwise the employee can make an after-tax personal contribution and we can advise on tax filing. Reach out if you want us to model the tax impact.
james (manager): appreciate the quick turnaround, kelly/ben/payroll.
olivia (eng): perfect — thanks everyone. i'll upload forms and tag this thread. :pray:
